item.title: The SCPs I attach to every AWS org
item.description: Service Control Policies are the cheapest, highest-leverage security control AWS gives you. Here are the four I put in place on day one of a new org.

item.title: Prompt injection: the defenses that actually hold up
item.description: Most "prompt injection defenses" are wishful thinking dressed up as engineering. Here is the short list of patterns that survive a real red-team week.

item.title: EventBridge rules for IAM, without drowning on-call
item.description: CloudTrail tells you what happened. EventBridge tells you the moment it happens — if you can write the pattern without paging on every CI deploy.

item.title: Suspicious IAM activity? Five CloudTrail lookups I run first
item.description: When someone says "something odd happened in IAM," you do not need a fancy SIEM on day one. CloudTrail already has the story — if you know which events to pull first.

item.title: IAM privilege escalation: patterns you'll actually see in the wild
item.description: AWS IAM privilege escalation isn't about zero-days. It's about abusing legitimate permissions in ways the account owner didn't intend. Here are the patterns that come up most often.
